reason: Same boundary as incall.rs: no Context in this module (BlocklistGlue.configure passes only the files dir). Wrapped in amos_jni::jni_call! so a failed resolution cannot poison the thread. Follow-up: resolve the class from BlocklistGlue_configure (a Java upcall) and cache the global ref.

Sync only (`rotation_set`): Tauri runs a sync command on the main thread, whose loader IS the app's, so naming RotationGlue is correct here. Same follow-up as ble.rs — resolve through the Context — if this command ever becomes `async` (REQ-A1867 / F-AND-017).

Sync only (scheduler_alarm_register/cancel/open_settings): Tauri runs a sync command on the main thread, whose loader IS the app's, so naming AlarmGlue is correct here. Same follow-up as ble.rs — resolve through the Context — if any of these becomes `async` (REQ-A1867 / F-AND-017).
